description: The donut chart visually represents the composition of the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, segmented into six distinct categories as defined in the legend: Moroccan Names (orange), Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy) (purple), Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives) (brown), Translated Sentences (yellow), Extra + Augmented Data (blue), and Pending Translations (green). The chart displays absolute counts rather than percentages, with three segments explicitly labeled: “Pending Translations” at 43,000 (green), “Translated Sentences” at 45,387 (yellow), and “Extra + Augmented Data” at 30,000 (blue). The remaining three categories — Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories, and Syntactic Roles — are represented by smaller, unlabeled slices, with the purple slice for Semantic Categories appearing particularly narrow. The chart uses a 3D effect and a central hole, with the largest segment being “Translated Sentences,” followed by “Pending Translations,” and then “Extra + Augmented Data,” suggesting a descending order of contribution by volume. No percentage values are shown, and the legend is positioned to the right of the chart for reference.
